name: @epoch/execution-tracking
description: Epoch Execution Tracking kernel (W038) — the universal REALIZATION-TRACKING layer and low-friction field-observation ingestion over @epoch/solution-delivery (W036): construction execution is ONE projection; build/deployment/fabrication/installation/commissioning vocabulary maps onto the same spine. Typed, sealed, append-only work-package/activity state tracking records referencing ProgramOfWork items by OPAQUE ID (schedule authority STAYS in ProgramOfWork — tracking records OBSERVE, never re-schedule); progress actualization as W036 Observation-distinction records whose actualization flows ONLY through the W036 DeliveryRecord acceptance/actualization path (this package produces observations and reconciles them — it NEVER writes Actual records directly; actualization-bypass-rejected); labor/equipment/material/resource usage observations (content-addressed, quantity+unit+time+provenance+mandatory uncertainty); field evidence references by W006 digest with capture context (never payloads); changes/delays/rework/defects/blockers with severity+impact references+resolution state (rework references original work records; blockers carry dependency semantics); confidence/provenance/freshness on EVERY observation (uncertainty-missing-rejected); replay/idempotent observation handling (duplicate-observation typed admission returning the prior digest); explicit Observation-NE-Actual separation with typed reconciliation proposals the W036 authority accepts/actualizes. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary (field systems stay behind the service-layer FieldCapturePort seam).
